summary: The PR fixes the issue with Matrix.col_insert() by correcting the column shifting logic. The added test ensures the fix works as expected.

issues.description: The addition of new test files (reproduce_bug.py and test_col_insert.py) is not directly related to fixing the bug in col_insert(). These could be considered unnecessary additions.
The test_col_insert.py script includes print statements which are not typically used in test files. It could be refactored to use proper assertions and logging.
